svg.title: Draw it yourself: Week 29
svg.desc: A large empty framed panel with a dashed inner border and faint centre text reading your diagram here. The prompt asks the learner to draw one deck cut into two piles that add back up, showing which pile fit sees, which pile predict sees, and where the test answers are kept.
svg.text: One deck, one cut, and two piles that must add back up.
Show which pile fit sees, which pile predict sees, and where y_test is kept.
